project.title: ActiveCampaign App
project.goal: Integrate the value of ActiveCampaign with the lives of our clients by providing key features on the go, allowing them to manage their business wherever they are.
project.value: A streamlined, intuitive interface lets users review important campaign and automation performance whenever they want, and the built-in CRM lets them manage their entire sales team and pipeline from the field. The app keeps business owners connected to customers, not their computer.
project.role: I led design of two iOS and Android apps, working on a cross-functional team with a product manager and five iOS and five Android engineers.

next.title: Global Search
next.goal: Add Global Search to Basis, giving users a quick way to find content, move between views, and take common actions from anywhere in the platform.
next.value: Basis spans several roles and functions within adtech, and users managing multiple campaigns found its complex hierarchy painful to navigate. A dynamic global search lets them comb through unstructured data and quickly find what they want, when they need it most.
next.role: I was the UI designer, working very closely with a UX designer, product, and engineering.
